mapper.sql: P.PROMOTION_NO, P.TRIAL_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, B.ORG_NAME, T.TITLE, T.PHASE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, P.STATUS AS PROMOTION_STATUS, P.REJECT_REASON, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.END_DATE AS SUBSCRIPTION_END_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TRIAL_PROMOTION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO ORDER BY CASE P.STATUS WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 2 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PROMOTION_NO DESC

SELECT FROM TRIAL_PROMOTION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO WHERE P.PROMOTION_NO = #{promotionNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIAL_PROMOTION SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', START_DATE = SYSDATE, END_DATE = NULL, REJECT_REASON = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PROMOTION_NO = #{promotionNo} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = T.BUSINESS_NO WHERE T.TRIAL_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.TRIAL_NO AND T.BUSINESS_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.BUSINESS_NO AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND B.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S WHERE S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.SUBSCRIPTION_NO AND S.BUSINESS_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.BUSINESS_NO AND S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.END_DATE IS NULL OR S.END_DATE > SYSDATE) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRIAL_PROMOTION P2 WHERE P2.TRIAL_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.TRIAL_NO AND P2.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P2.PROMOTION_NO <> TRIAL_PROMOTION.PROMOTION_NO )
UPDATE TRIAL_PROMOTION SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PROMOTION_NO = #{promotionNo} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG ( REVIEW_LOG_NO, ADMIN_MEMBER_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO, ACTION_TYPE, REASON, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{adminMemberNo}, 'PROMOTION', #{promotionNo}, #{actionType}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIAL_PROMOTION SET STATUS = 'ENDED', END_DATE = CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE) ELSE END_DATE END, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S WHERE S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.SUBSCRIPTION_NO AND S.BUSINESS_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.BUSINESS_NO AND S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.END_DATE IS NULL OR S.END_DATE > SYSDATE) ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = T.BUSINESS_NO WHERE T.TRIAL_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.TRIAL_NO AND T.BUSINESS_NO = TRIAL_PROMOTION.BUSINESS_NO AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND B.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ) )
